theater: 厄勒海峽與丹麥挪威沿岸

battle.name: 炮艦戰爭
battle.theater: 厄勒海峽與丹麥挪威沿岸
battle.brief: 一八〇七年第二次哥本哈根之戰後，丹麥—挪威主力艦隊盡失，遂以逾二百艘小型炮艇在厄勒海峽、大小貝爾特與挪威沿岸對抗皇家海軍的封鎖，戰事延續到一八一四年。線列步兵早已用火槍與刺刀取代方陣長槍，長槍只餘兩種用途：城防民兵徵用的長矛，以及登船奪船時的冷兵器近身。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 丹麥—挪威一方是丹麥王國與挪威王國組成的共主邦聯，國王克里斯蒂安七世在位而實權落在王儲腓特烈六世手中，海軍最高權力集中於克里斯蒂安堡的海軍總部與總監制之下，炮艇總隊由海軍少將斯滕·安德森·比勒統率；挪威沿岸另有一套由海軍與海岸民兵共同經營的要塞守備體系，克里斯蒂安堡港內還泊著供炮艇預備水手駐紮的巡防艦「海豚」號。英方是倫敦海軍部與皇家海軍的全球體系，北歐分遣隊由旗艦率數支巡邏支隊組成，旗艦指揮官先後有威廉·卡思卡特、詹姆斯·甘比爾與喬治·伍德，另有大批英籍私掠船與徵用武裝商船加入封鎖與偵察。瑞典起初保持中立，一八〇八至〇九年的丹瑞戰役與一八一三至一四年的荷爾斯泰因戰役中站在英方一邊；俄羅斯在芬蘭戰爭中與丹麥同陣營，拿破崙的法國則是丹麥的政治與物資後盾。英國在歐洲大陸與地中海的戰事同樣吃緊，海軍只能以分隊巡邏的方式維持北歐存在，這正是丹麥敢於以小艇周旋的客觀條件；整場戰爭因此是一個全球體系與一個近海小國在北海互相消耗的例子。
countriesEn: The Danish–Norwegian side was a personal union of the Kingdom of Denmark and the Kingdom of Norway. King Christian VII sat on the throne while the real power lay with the crown prince Frederick VI. Naval authority was concentrated in the naval headquarters and the directorate system at Copenhagen, and the gunboat flotilla was commanded by Admiral Steen Andersen Bille. Along the Norwegian coast there was a separate system of shore defences run jointly by the navy and the coastal militia, and the frigate Triton, in ordinary, lay in Copenhagen harbour to quarter the reserve crews of the gunboats. The British side was the global system of the Admiralty in London and the Royal Navy. The northern detachment was built around a flag ship and several cruising squadrons, with William Cathcart, James Gambier and George Wood as flag officers in turn, and a large number of British privateers and hired armed vessels joined the blockade and the scouting. Sweden was at first neutral and later sided with Britain in the Dano-Swedish war of 1808–09 and in the campaign in Holstein in 1813–14. Russia fought on the same side as Denmark in the Finnish War, and Napoleonic France was Denmark's political and material backer. British commitments in Europe and in the Mediterranean were heavy at the same time, so the navy could only maintain its presence in northern Europe by patrolling in small detachments, and that was precisely the opening the Danes needed to manoeuvre their small craft. The whole war is therefore an example of a global system and a coastal minor power wearing each other down in the North Sea.
people: 關鍵人物分散在兩國的艦隊與宮廷之間。丹麥方面，克里斯蒂安七世是名義上的國君，王儲腓特烈六世才是主導對英談判與軍費籌措的人；海軍少將斯滕·安德森·比勒自一八〇七年起把以小艇周旋的戰術推到核心位置，被視為丹麥以小博大策略的主要設計者；海軍少尉漢斯·喬治·加德在報告中把丹麥炮艇分為加諾·查魯彭、加諾·約倫、莫爾特·查魯彭與莫爾特·巴克塞四型，逐型列出火炮、人數與編制，是這套兵種最完整的一手技術記錄；海軍准將約阿希姆·卡斯滕斯基奧爾德、卡爾·威廉·耶森、克里斯蒂安·約根森、尤里·法爾森等人分別主持各次遠征，海軍少尉尼古拉·圖克森在弗拉德斯特蘭率炮艇隊奪取英軍火砲快船，佩德·尼古拉·斯基布斯特德中尉在耶林附近奪取英軍炮艇，克里格中校則在厄勒海峽率二十五艘炮艇與七艘武裝小艇攻擊英軍主力艦。英方，威廉·卡思卡特以旗艦指揮官身份在北歐巡航，詹姆斯·甘比爾接任，喬治·伍德負責收緊封鎖線；托馬斯·麥克納馬拉·羅素海軍中將報導赫利戈蘭島的投降，威廉·塞爾比與愛德華·尼科爾斯率海軍陸戰隊攻取安霍爾特島，理查德·拜倫、喬治·帕克與詹姆斯·斯圖爾特輪流指揮支隊，喬治·斯圖亞特勳爵在一次奪船行動中率小艇登船。至於卡面那件長槍，在這批人物的手上早已不是制式裝備：它只是老兵隨身帶著的舊物、城市守備與民兵手中徵用的長矛，以及登船突擊隊背在肩上的接舷長槍。
peopleEn: The decisive figures were scattered between the fleets and the courts of the two countries. On the Danish side Christian VII was the nominal sovereign, while the crown prince Frederick VI was the man who actually directed the negotiations with Britain and the raising of money for the war. Admiral Steen Andersen Bille pushed the manoeuvre of small craft into the centre of Danish strategy from 1807 and is credited as the principal designer of the policy of hitting a materially stronger enemy with tiny boats. The junior lieutenant Hans Georg Garde, in his report, sorted the Danish gunboats into four classes — the Kanonchaluppen, the Kanonjollen, the Morterschaluppen and the Morterbarkasserne — listing the guns, the crews and the establishments of each, and this remains the fullest first-hand technical record of the arm. The commodores Joachim Castenskiöld, Carl Wilhelm Jessen, Christian Jürgensen and Ulrik Fabricius Fasmer led the expeditions in turn; the naval lieutenant Nicolai H. Tuxen took the gunboats out of Fladstrand and captured a British gun-brig, First Lieutenant Peter Nicolay Skibsted took a British gunboat off the Jutland coast, and Commodore J. C. Krieger commanded twenty-five gunboats and seven armed launches against a British ship of the line in the Sound. On the British side William Cathcart cruised in northern Europe as flag officer, James Gambier succeeded him, and George Wood tightened the blockade line; Rear Admiral Thomas McNamara Russell reported the capitulation of Heligoland, Captain William Selby and Captain Edward Nicolls landed marines to take Anholt, Richard Byron, George Parker and James Stuart commanded squadrons in turn, and Lord George Stuart led the boats in one cutting-out action. As for the pike on the card, it was long out of issue with all of these men: it survived only as an old piece carried by veterans, as spears requisitioned by town guards and militia, and as the boarding pikes that assault parties carried on their shoulders.
kits: 裝備方面，先要說明一件容易被誤解的事：這張卡的長槍，指的是一六〇〇年前後的方陣長矛（pike／espingarda），密西西比之役之後它仍與火槍一同站在方陣的後列，讓火槍隊在前面成排射擊。到一八〇七年，這件兵器在丹麥與瑞典的線列步兵中早已被火槍與刺刀取代，軍械庫裡剩下的多是老兵的私人舊物。它仍有三種實際用法：一是城市守備與沿岸民兵徵用的民間長矛、漁叉與舊矛頭，用來補上火槍裝藥與換裝之間的空檔；二是登船奪船時的冷兵器，海軍陸戰隊、水手與登船突擊隊都備有短柄矛與接舷長槍，炮艇偷襲商船之後，雙方在甲板上短兵相接，最後幾尺就是刺刀與矛鋒的距離；三是儀式與象徵，長槍仍作連隊旗桿與衝鋒的標誌，老兵退伍時習慣把矛帶在身邊。真正決定這場戰爭勝負的裝備是別的東西：丹麥—挪威在失去主力艦隊後建造的炮艇，設計出自瑞典人弗雷德里克·亨里克·阿夫·查普曼，分為加諾·查魯彭、加諾·約倫、莫爾特·查魯彭與莫爾特·巴克塞四型，前者裝兩門二十四磅砲與四門四磅臼砲，後者裝一百磅臼砲；英方則靠卡隆砲、臼炮艦、二十四磅與十八磅主砲，以及一八〇八年八月「普羅米修斯」號投入戰場的康格里夫火箭。丹麥在一八〇八至一一年間另於卑爾根與特隆赫姆建造十艘可應付較惡劣海面的縱式炮艇。
kitsEn: On equipment, one point has to be cleared up first, because it is easy to misread the card: the pike shown is the formation pike of around 1600, and after the fighting over the Mississippi it still stood in the rear rank of the square beside the muskets, letting the musketeers shoot in front. By 1807 the arm had long been replaced in the line infantry of both Denmark and Sweden by musket and bayonet, and what remained in the arsenals was mostly the private property of old soldiers. It still had three real uses. First, town guards and the coastal militia requisitioned civilian spears, fishing pikes and old socketed heads to plug the gap between the moment a musket was loaded and the moment it could be fired again. Second, in boarding actions: marines, sailors and boarding parties carried short pikes and boarding pikes, and once a gunboat had surprised a merchantman the two sides met at close quarters on the deck, where the last few feet were measured by bayonet and spear point. Third, ceremony and symbol — the pike remained the colour-pole of a company and the emblem of the charge, and old men habitually carried one away when they were discharged. The equipment that actually decided this war was something else. The gunboats Denmark–Norway built after the loss of the battle fleet were designed by the Swede Fredrik Henrik af Chapman and came in four classes, the Kanonchaluppen, the Kanonjollen, the Morterschaluppen and the Morterbarkasserne, the first pair carrying two 24-pounder guns and four 4-pounder howitzers, the mortar types carrying a 100-pounder mortar. The British relied on carronades, bomb vessels, 24- and 18-pounder main guns, and the Congreve rockets first put into action by HMS Prometheus in August 1808. Denmark built ten further schooner-rigged gunboats at Bergen and Trondheim between 1808 and 1811, hulls able to work in rougher water.
tactics: 雙方的戰術都圍繞淺水與封鎖兩個條件展開。丹麥炮艇幾乎全為近岸而設：吃水淺、轉向靈活、目標小，適合在厄勒海峽、大貝爾特、小貝爾特與挪威峽灣的窄水道活動，但中一發就容易沉，禁不起惡浪，也不宜正面硬撼主力艦。實際打法是分縱隊伏擊與掠奪商船：炮艇常分成三艘一隊、十五艘一隊展開，以縱射火力壓住敵艦尾部，迫其捱受後方射擊；多以夜航與突然出現的方式接近，也曾假借他國旗號混入貝爾特海峽，趁英艦修理時偷襲船塢；臼炮艇則用來對付封鎖線與岸上砲台，發射數發後往往因船體進水而回港重填。英方的對策是封鎖加反游擊：以分隊巡邏封住航道，掩護大商隊由厄勒海峽與大貝爾特出入，奪取丹麥私掠船與商船作為戰利品，同時在多座丹麥島嶼登陸，取得柴薪、淡水與牲畜，甚至北上巴倫支海襲擊哈斯維克與哈默費斯特，切斷波莫爾貿易。丹麥後來改以炮艇為商船護航，限制貨船必須在莫恩島內側航行，輔以沿岸的號誌與傳令，把糧食一批批送入克里斯蒂安堡。陸上方面，一八〇七年三月的斯特拉斯堡之戰屬近身巷戰，攻守雙方在街壘與城門內以火槍、刺刀與徵用長矛糾纏，是方陣長槍退場前最後一類近戰場合之一；一八〇八至〇九年的丹瑞陸上戰線則以線列步兵的縱深射擊與縱隊衝鋒為主。
tacticsEn: The tactics of both sides turned on two conditions, shoal water and blockade. The Danish gunboats were designed almost entirely for coast work: shallow draught, quick handling, small targets, ideal in the narrow channels of the Sound, the Great Belt, the Little Belt and the Norwegian fjords, but easy to sink from a single hit, unable to ride out a heavy sea and ineffective against a ship of the line head-on. The method in practice was ambush by divisions and the seizure of merchant shipping. The gunboats commonly formed up in divisions of three and of fifteen, working their fire in echelon onto the stern of a ship so that it took the shot from astern. Approaches were usually made at night and by sudden appearance, and Dutch or other neutral colours were sometimes hoisted to slip into the Belts and raid the dockyard while British ships were under repair. The mortar vessels were used against the blockade line and the shore batteries, and after a few shells they often leaked so badly that they had to return to harbour, have the mortar taken out and the hull recaulked. The British answer was blockade plus anti-guerrilla work: squadron patrols closed the channels and escorted the great convoys out through the Sound and the Great Belt, took Danish privateers and merchantmen as prizes, landed on several Danish islands to draw firewood, fresh water and livestock, and even pushed north into the Barents Sea to raid Hasvik and Hammerfest and cut the Pomor trade. Denmark later used her gunboats to escort her own merchants, restricted cargo ships to the inner side of Møn, and combined this with coastal signalling and dispatch riders to bring grain into Copenhagen in batches. On land, the fighting at Stralsund in March 1807 was close-quarter work in the streets, where attackers and defenders closed at the barricades and the gate with muskets, bayonets and requisitioned spears — one of the last kinds of melee in which the formation pike still had a place. On the Dano-Swedish land front of 1808–09 the emphasis was on the deep fire and the advance of the line infantry.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。丹麥—挪威在損失主力艦隊後建造的炮艇總數超過二百艘，大型炮艇乘員七十六人、小型二十四人；按海軍少尉加德的分型，最大一型戰時編制六十九至七十九人，次型四十一人，臼炮型四十人，最小型十九人。逐場的數字也有記錄：一八〇八年三月二十二日澤蘭角之戰，英方「納索」號陣亡一人、受傷十六人，「斯塔特利」號陣亡四人、受傷二十七人，丹麥末級戰艦「克里斯蒂安·腓特烈親王」號沉沒，丹方陣亡五十五人、受傷八十八人；同年四月廿二日英方在弗洛斯特蘭奪走五艘縱式船、三艘加利特與數艘小艇，合計約八百七十噸，英方五人受傷；六月四日四艘丹麥炮艇在四小時的戰鬥後奪取英軍「蒂克勒」號，該艦五十人編制中艦長與十四名水手陣亡，另有二十二人死傷；六月十九日六艘丹麥炮艇擊潰英軍「海鷗」號，該艦陣亡八人、受傷二十人，含艦長在內；十月廿日厄勒海峽，二十五艘丹麥炮艇與七艘武裝小艇圍攻英軍七十四砲主力艦「非洲」號，英方陣亡九人、受傷五十一人。一八〇九年五月十八日英軍攻取安霍爾特島，守軍一百七十人，英方海軍陸戰隊一人陣亡、二人受傷；六月九日丹麥—挪威二十一艘炮艇與七艘臼炮艇在薩爾特霍爾姆攻擊七十艘商船，奪走十二至十三艘商船與一艘護衛艦；九月二日弗拉德斯特蘭的炮艇隊奪取英軍火砲快船「鼴鼠」號，英方二人陣亡、九人受傷。一八一〇年四月十三日四艘丹麥炮艇奪取裝一門二十四磅砲與一門卡隆砲的「磨石」號，英方二人陣亡、二人受傷。一八一一年四月二十三日「天鵝」號在松寧松德遭三艘丹麥炮艇射擊，火藥艙進水被迫投降，陣亡二人，後在烏德瓦拉外海沉沒；同年五月十一日「來福槍手」號在設得蘭外海追了十二小時奪回裝十二門砲、五十八人的「阿爾班」號；七月三十一日英方兩艦在朗厄峽灣對上裝二十砲、十八砲與十六砲的三艘丹麥巡防艦，因火力占優而退。一八一二年七月六日林格峽之戰，英方擊毀挪威護衛艦「娜雅登」號；八月二日英軍奪取丹麥兩艘武裝船與一艘約四百噸的美國商船，英方陣亡九人、受傷十六人，丹方陣亡十人、受傷十三人。
dataEn: The verifiable figures run roughly as follows. Denmark–Norway built more than two hundred gunboats after the loss of the battle fleet, the large type carrying seventy-six men and the small type twenty-four; in Garde’s classification the largest class had a wartime establishment of sixty-nine to seventy-nine men, the next forty-one, the mortar class forty and the smallest nineteen. The individual actions are also on record. At the Battle of Zealand Point on 22 March 1808 HMS Nassau lost one man killed and sixteen wounded and HMS Stately four killed and twenty-seven wounded, while the last Danish ship of the line, HDMS Prinds Christian Frederik, was destroyed, the Danes losing fifty-five killed and eighty-eight wounded. On 22 April British boats drove a convoy ashore at Flodstrand and brought out five brigs, three galliots and several small craft totalling some 870 tons, at the cost of five men wounded. On 4 June four Danish gunboats took HMS Tickler after four hours, the fifty-man ship losing her captain and fourteen men killed and a further twenty-two killed or wounded. On 19 June six Danish gunboats beat up HMS Seagull, which lost eight men killed and twenty wounded, her captain among them. On 20 October in the Sound, twenty-five Danish gunboats and seven armed launches surrounded the 74-gun HMS Africa, which lost nine killed and fifty-one wounded. On 18 May 1809 the British took Anholt, whose garrison of one hundred and seventy men put up a sharp but fruitless resistance, one marine being killed and two wounded; on 9 June a Dano-Norwegian flotilla of twenty-one gunboats and seven mortar boats attacked seventy merchantmen off Saltholm and took twelve or thirteen of them with an escort; on 2 September the gunboats from Fladstrand under Tuxen captured the gun-brig HMS Minx, two killed and nine wounded. On 13 April 1810 four gunboats captured HMS Grinder, armed with a 24-pounder and a 24-pounder carronade, two of her men killed and two wounded. On 23 April 1811 HMS Swan was driven to surrender at Sunningsund after her powder magazine was wetted, two of her men killed, and she sank off Uddevalla; on 11 May HMS Rifleman chased Alban for twelve hours off Shetland and retook her, she being armed with twelve guns and fifty-eight men; on 31 July two British ships met three Danish brigs mounting twenty, eighteen and sixteen guns in Long Sound and withdrew before the heavier weight of metal. On 6 July 1812 the British destroyed the Norwegian frigate Najaden at Lyngør, and on 2 August they cut out two Danish vessels and an American merchantman of some 400 tons, the British losing nine killed and sixteen wounded and the Danes ten killed and thirteen wounded.
cause: 起因是拿破崙的大陸封鎖體系與北歐中立國的武裝中立政策正面相撞。一八〇一年第一次哥本哈根之戰後，丹麥—挪威宣稱武裝中立，用海軍保護出入丹麥與挪威水域的商船；英國要把北海貿易從法國體系中切開，就要求丹麥交出艦隊加入封鎖，拿破崙亦要求丹麥封鎖英國。一八〇七年英國砲轟哥本哈根，艦隊在港口被奪或被毀，局勢再也無法挽回：丹麥失去了可以與皇家海軍抗衡的骨幹，於是轉向以小艇周旋的非常手段，這也是「炮艦戰爭」得名的原因。另一條導火線在丹麥與瑞典之間：一八〇七年三月起，兩國在特羅爾海特運河的工地與荷爾斯泰因的斯特拉斯堡一帶衝突升級，丹麥軍隊進入運河工地被瑞典軍隊驅逐，關係隨之破裂；一八〇八年三月瑞典軍在貝納多特率領下越過邊界，衝突全面化，英方也在這個過程中站到了瑞典一邊。英方另有一層戰略考慮：波羅的海與波莫爾航線正在被拿破崙的體系收編，英國必須維持北德的航路，並把封鎖延伸到俄國北方，巴倫支海航線因此成為打擊目標；而丹麥—挪威很清楚，只要商船無法出海，幾年之後自己的海軍與國庫都會耗盡。
causeEn: The cause was the collision of Napoleon’s continental blockade system with the armed neutrality of the northern neutral powers. After the First Battle of Copenhagen in 1801 Denmark–Norway proclaimed armed neutrality and used its navy to protect merchants trading into and out of Danish and Norwegian waters. Britain, wanting to cut the North Sea trade away from the French system, demanded that Denmark hand over its fleet to join the blockade, and Napoleon in turn demanded that Denmark blockade Britain. In 1807 the British bombarded Copenhagen; the fleet was either taken or destroyed in the harbour and the situation could not be undone. Denmark had lost the backbone with which it could have stood up to the Royal Navy, and turned by necessity to the extraordinary measure of fighting with small craft — hence the name of the Gunboat War. A second fuse lay between Denmark and Sweden: from March 1807 clashes escalated around the works on the Trollhätta canal and at Stralsund in Holstein, Danish troops entering the canal works being driven out by Swedish troops, and relations broke down accordingly. In March 1808 Swedish troops crossed the frontier under Bernadotte and the conflict became general, and the British fell in behind Sweden in the course of it. The British had a further strategic calculation: the Baltic and the Pomor route were being drawn into Napoleon’s system, so the northern German trade had to be kept open and the blockade extended into Russian waters, which made the Barents Sea route a target. Denmark–Norway, for its part, understood perfectly well that if the merchantmen could not sail, within a few years its navy and its treasury alike would be spent.
impact: 影響首先是北歐地緣格局的重排。一八一四年一月十四日《基爾條約》結束戰爭：赫利戈蘭割予英國，挪威王國（格陵蘭、冰島與法羅群島除外）割予瑞典王，瑞典的波美拉尼亞歸丹麥，丹麥取回安霍爾特島並獲得薩克斯－勞恩堡作為補償。挪威人拒絕接受條約把挪威當作一枚可以交易的棋子的安排，一八一四年七月二十六日瑞挪戰爭爆發，挪威乘亂在五月十七日制憲，一八一五年被迫與瑞典結盟，這條尾聲直接通向一九〇五年的挪威完全獨立。對丹麥而言，七年封鎖把一個航運大國變成一個小艇民族：海軍主力被摧毀後重建的只剩下淺水炮艇隊與商船護航體系，造船重心也從遠洋主力艦轉向峽灣小艇，這一取向在其後一百年裡一直存在，直到一八六〇年代木殼蒸汽護衛艦重新問世。對英國而言，這是一場成本低而收益高的勝利：封鎖逼出了《基爾條約》，皇家海軍沒有損失一條主力艦就取得了北歐貿易的通行權，赫利戈蘭也成為對付法國的走私與間諜基地。整場衝突同時是英國在北海制海權的實地檢驗，說明分隊巡邏加封鎖確實能壓制一支擁有海岸民兵與大量小艇的近海力量。
impactEn: The first effect was a reordering of the northern European map. The Treaty of Kiel of 14 January 1814 closed the war: Heligoland went to Britain, the Kingdom of Norway — Greenland, Iceland and the Faroes excepted — went to the King of Sweden, Swedish Pomerania went to Denmark, and Denmark got Anholt back together with the Duchy of Saxe-Lauenburg in compensation. The Norwegian people refused to accept the treaty’s treatment of Norway as a counter in a bargain, and the Norwegian–Swedish War broke out on 26 July 1814; Norway used the confusion to promulgate its constitution on 17 May and was forced into union with Sweden in 1815, a thread that runs straight on to Norway’s full independence in 1905. For Denmark the seven years of blockade turned a great shipping country into a small-boat nation: with the battle fleet destroyed, what was rebuilt was a shallow-draft gunboat force and a convoy system, and the centre of gravity of Danish shipbuilding shifted from ocean-going capital ships to fjord craft, an orientation that lasted for the better part of a century, until wooden-hulled steam corvettes came back into fashion in the 1860s. For Britain this was a victory bought cheaply and profitably: the blockade forced the Treaty of Kiel, the Royal Navy obtained a free passage for northern trade without losing a single ship of the line, and Heligoland became a base for smuggling and espionage against France. The whole conflict was at the same time a practical test of British sea power in the North Sea, showing that patrol squadrons backed by a blockade could indeed hold down a coastal force equipped with a shore militia and a swarm of small craft.
result: 雙方都沒有取得完全的勝利。英國在七年裡始終控制丹麥水域，能把大商隊護送出厄勒海峽，並在多次交火中重創丹麥炮艇隊，但始終無法把丹麥的抵抗連根拔起：丹麥炮艇先後奪取英軍「蒂克勒」號、「海鷗」號、「虎」號、「鼴鼠」號、「磨石」號與「阿爾班」號等數十艘船艦與商船，一八〇八年十月更在厄勒海峽重創英軍七十四砲主力艦「非洲」號，使英方護航體系屢屢受挫；一八〇九年六月在薩爾特霍爾姆，二十餘艘炮艇一次奪走十二三艘商船，說明封鎖線上仍有可以反擊的拳頭；一八一一年二月近千名炮艇人員進攻安霍爾特島，雖因傷亡過重而撤回，卻也證明封鎖線並非牢不可破。丹麥—挪威則輸在時間：切斷商船航路就等於切斷國庫的稅源，七年之間戰果多為暫時性的奪船，而英方能持續恢復航運。決定性的轉折在一八一三年十二月，瑞典軍在第六次反法同盟戰爭中自荷爾斯泰因登陸，逼近丹麥本土，首都與離島直接受威脅，丹麥—挪威被迫求和。一八一四年一月十四日《基爾條約》簽訂，戰爭以割地收場：挪威割予瑞典，赫利戈蘭割予英國，瑞典波美拉尼亞轉讓丹麥。戰後挪威民眾拒不承認這項安排，瑞挪戰爭隨即開打，把北歐的局勢又拖進新的十年。
resultEn: Neither side won outright. Britain held the Danish waters throughout the seven years, escorted the great convoys out through the Sound and mauled the Danish gunboat flotilla again and again, yet it never rooted out the Danish resistance: the gunboats took HMS Tickler, HMS Seagull, HMS Tigress, HMS Minx, HMS Grinder and HMS Alban in turn, together with dozens of other warships and merchantmen, and in October 1808 they mauled the 74-gun HMS Africa in the Sound so badly that the British escort system was repeatedly embarrassed. In June 1809 off Saltholm more than twenty gunboats at a single stroke carried off twelve or thirteen merchantmen, showing that the blockade line could still be hit; and in February 1811 close on a thousand gunboat hands and soldiers attempted to retake Anholt, breaking off after heavy loss but proving that the cordon was not unbreakable. Denmark–Norway, on the other hand, lost on time: to cut off the merchant shipping was to cut off the revenue of the treasury, and over seven years the results were mostly the temporary seizure of shipping while the British steadily restored their own. The decisive turn came in December 1813, when Swedish troops landed in Holstein in the War of the Sixth Coalition and closed on the Danish homeland, putting the capital and the island fortresses directly in danger and forcing Denmark–Norway to sue for peace. The Treaty of Kiel was signed on 14 January 1814 and the war ended in a cession of territory: Norway to Sweden, Heligoland to Britain, Swedish Pomerania to Denmark. The Norwegian people refused to accept the arrangement, the Norwegian–Swedish War broke out, and the affairs of the north were dragged into a further decade of trouble.
